brief:
Recent messages in Kevin's Hermes chat (newest last):
Kevin: remind me, when's the dentist?
Hermes: Your dentist appointment is Friday at 3:30 pm with Dr. Patel.
Kevin: can you explain what a write-ahead log is, short version
Hermes: A write-ahead log records every change to an append-only file before the change touches the main data files. After a crash the database replays the log to finish or undo half-done work, so a commit is durable once its log record is flushed. SQLite, Postgres and most key-value stores use one; the tradeoff is an extra sequential write per commit, which is cheap compared to random writes.
Kevin: give me three sci-fi books like Project Hail Mary
Hermes: Try The Martian by the same author for the problem-solving tone, Children of Time by Adrian Tchaikovsky for first contact told from the alien side, and Blindsight by Peter Watts if you want something darker and stranger about what intelligence is.
Kevin: and Harsha's flight?
Hermes: Harsha's flight UA 1184 lands at 6:40 pm at Austin airport, terminal A.
Kevin: how does a heat pump heat a house when it's freezing outside
Hermes: The refrigerant boils at a temperature far below the outdoor air, so even freezing air still has heat to give it. A compressor then squeezes the gas, which raises its temperature well above room temperature, and the indoor coil releases that heat into the house. Efficiency falls as it gets colder, which is why cold-climate models use variable-speed compressors and some homes keep a backup heater for the coldest nights.
Kevin: what did we cap the Tokyo trip at
Hermes: The Tokyo trip budget is $1,800 for flights and hotel, food separate.
Kevin: how do I stop git from asking for my passphrase every push
Hermes: Load the key into the agent once per login with ssh-add, and on macOS add UseKeychain yes and AddKeysToAgent yes under your Host entry in ~/.ssh/config so the passphrase lives in the keychain. After that, pushes over SSH reuse the unlocked key without prompting.
Kevin: which voice engine is default now
Hermes: GPT-Live is the default voice engine. Grok Voice is switchable; on the frozen bench Grok passed 24 of 24 runs and GPT-Live 17 of 24.
Kevin: what's a quick stretch for a stiff lower back
Hermes: Try a knees-to-chest hold: lie on your back, pull both knees in, hold for 30 seconds while breathing slowly, then rock gently side to side. Follow it with a cat-cow on hands and knees for ten slow rounds. Stop if anything feels sharp rather than tight.
Kevin: how much memory does the studio have
Hermes: The Mac Studio is an M5 Max with 36 GB of unified memory and about 217 GB of free disk.
Kevin: why does my sourdough come out flat
Hermes: Flat loaves usually mean the dough over-proofed or the starter was past its peak. Use the starter when it has doubled and still domes, shorten the bulk ferment when the kitchen is warm, and shape with more surface tension. A cold overnight proof in the fridge also makes the dough easier to score and gives better oven spring.
Kevin: ok. also you have my OK to read my phone screen over adb during calls.
Hermes: Noted: adb screen access during calls is approved.
